lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Twelve years ago. The Master sent|for two of his four. Only two.
lines.text: Twelve years ago. The Master sent for two of his four. Only two.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Ysolde. Torvald. Hold the isle. Whatever climbs|out of the water must not touch this stone.
lines.text: Ysolde. Torvald. Hold the isle. Whatever climbs out of the water must not touch this stone.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: What is under it?
lines.text: What is under it?

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: My first mistake. His name was Obren.
lines.text: My first mistake. His name was Obren.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Should we send for Vessa and Malrik?
lines.text: Should we send for Vessa and Malrik?

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Vessa would burn it open to see inside.|Malrik would ask what it pays. No.
lines.text: Vessa would burn it open to see inside. Malrik would ask what it pays. No.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Something under the isle is counting.|Every one that falls, it counts.
lines.text: Something under the isle is counting. Every one that falls, it counts.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Master. You came yourself.|I am honoured. Kneel a little longer.
lines.text: Master. You came yourself. I am honoured. Kneel a little longer.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: Then the isle split, and the|amber came up through the stones.
lines.text: Then the isle split, and the amber came up through the stones.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Torvald! It's breaking on our side!
lines.text: Torvald! It's breaking on our side!

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: Then I am on your side. Hold.
lines.text: Then I am on your side. Hold.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: It will not hold from up here. Not for long.
lines.text: It will not hold from up here. Not for long.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Come down, old man. Hold my door yourself.|Learn how long a year is in the dark.
lines.text: Come down, old man. Hold my door yourself. Learn how long a year is in the dark.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Master. You can't go down there.
lines.text: Master. You can't go down there.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Someone must. I have always|been the one who must.
lines.text: Someone must. I have always been the one who must.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: A wood-girl, a snowman and a tired old man.|I can wait. Stone is patient.
lines.text: A wood-girl, a snowman and a tired old man. I can wait. Stone is patient.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Listen, both of you. Tell no one what sleeps|here. If the world knows, the world will dig.
lines.text: Listen, both of you. Tell no one what sleeps here. If the world knows, the world will dig.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: My regalia are its keys. When I go, they|will scatter. Never let them sit in one hand.
lines.text: My regalia are its keys. When I go, they will scatter. Never let them sit in one hand.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Ysolde, my heart: keep growing things.|Torvald, my patience: wait for me.
lines.text: Ysolde, my heart: keep growing things. Torvald, my patience: wait for me.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: How long?
lines.text: How long?

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: Not too long.
lines.text: Not too long.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: He went down that same night, to hold the|door from below. He never said for how long.
lines.text: He went down that same night, to hold the door from below. He never said for how long.

lines.speaker: master
lines.subtitle: The seal! Keep them off the stone!
lines.text: The seal! Keep them off the stone!

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Master... forgive me...
lines.text: Master... forgive me...

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Open. At last, open.
lines.text: Open. At last, open.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: That gate is closed. Roots don't forget.
lines.text: That gate is closed. Roots don't forget.

lines.speaker: torvald
lines.subtitle: One fewer door. Keep yours shut, Ysolde.
lines.text: One fewer door. Keep yours shut, Ysolde.
